headlines.description: — The Indianapolis Colts may start slow.
headlines.shortLinkText: Minshew throws for TD in OT as the Colts win 4th straight, down Titans 31-28

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — In weather that tormented the offenses, at least the Los Angeles Chargers had their kicking game to fall back on.
headlines.shortLinkText: With pair of FGs, Chargers beat Patriots and latest hapless QB, 6-0

events.name: Detroit Lions at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — For a rookie tight end from a college program not known for its offensive prowess, Sam LaPorta has been a quick study in the NFL and is playing a prominent role in what could be a special season for the Detroit Lions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam LaPorta has career day for Lions, Saints QB Derek Carr hurt as Detroit wins 33-28

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New York Jets

headlines.description: — The rain was falling, penalty flags were flying and the Atlanta Falcons kept slogging away.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ridder, Falcons do just enough to pull out an ugly 13-8 win over struggling Jets

headlines.description: — Forced to endure an unexpected “second halftime” after the skies opened up around Acrisure Stadium in the third quarter on Sunday, the Arizona Cardinals retreated to the locker room and tried to stay loose.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Conner scores twice against his old team, Kenny Pickett hurt as Cardinals beat Steelers 24-10

headlines.description: — Tyreek Hill wasn't surprised to see just one defender covering him. After catching a 78-yard touchdown pass, he was plenty thankful.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hill has 2 TDs as the Dolphins beat the Commanders 45-15. They're 9-3 for the 1st time since 2001

headlines.description: — Nico Collins had the best game of his career, and the Texans' defense came up huge to help Houston hand Denver its first loss since mid-October.
headlines.shortLinkText: Collins has 191 yards receiving, Ward saves game with interception as Texans beat Broncos 22-17

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Mike Evans sprinted between two defenders into the open, snagged a pass approaching midfield, and took off for the end zone.
headlines.shortLinkText: Evans scores on 75-yard TD, tops 1,000 yards for 10th straight year; Bucs beat Panthers 21-18

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford and the Los Angeles Rams have shown since coming off their bye week that this might not be another rebuilding season after all.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford throws 3 TD passes as Rams win 3rd straight, 36-19 over Browns

headlines.description: — Deebo Samuel talked so much smack after last season's NFC championship game, the box score almost needed a doublecheck to confirm that — yes, the 49ers did indeed lose to the Eagles.
headlines.shortLinkText: San Francisco's Brock Purdy throws 4 TD passes as 49ers thump injured Hurts, Eagles 42-19

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love showed the Kansas City Chiefs just how much he's learned since the last time he faced them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love throws 3 TD passes, Packers beat Chiefs 27-19 for 3rd straight win

headlines.description: — Jake Browning insists his first career start was the real surprise. Everyone else would disagree.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Browning steals spotlight as Bengals stun Jaguars 34-31 in OT. Trevor Lawrence injures ankle

events.name: New England Patriots at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — The wins used to come so easy and so often for David Andrews early in his career with the New England Patriots, the veteran center barely noticed them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bailey Zappe throws for 3 TDs, Patriots damage Steelers' playoff hopes with 21-18 win

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield knew the Falcons would be devoting plenty of attention to Mike Evans and Chris Godwin.
headlines.shortLinkText: Otton hauls in 11-yard scoring pass with 31 seconds left. Bucs beat Falcons 29-25

headlines.description: — The Chicago Bears could be excused for experiencing a few flashbacks as the final stretch unfolded with another comfortable lead over the Detroit Lions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Fields leads Bears to 28-13 win over NFC North-leading Lions

headlines.description: — In a span of six days, Jake Browning has gone from Joe Burrow's little-known backup to the potential savior of the Bengals' season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backup QB Jake Browning shines again as Bengals pound Colts 34-14 to stay in playoff mix

headlines.description: — When Joe Flacco arrived three weeks ago, Browns star Myles Garrett had his suspicions about what the 38-year-old quarterback had left.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Flacco throws 3 TD passes, Browns pick Trevor Lawrence 3 times in 31-27 win vs Jags

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Derek Carr sounded determined not to dwell on any dysfunction evident within the Saints' offense after New Orleans overcame three shaky quarters and did enough to defeat the team with the NFL's worst record.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Carr overcomes recent injuries and rough start, leads Saints past Panthers 28-6

events.name: Houston Texans at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Zach Wilson overcame a sluggish start, some big hits and a week of criticism and controversy by responding with the type of impressive performance the New York Jets have long been expecting.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Wilson leads Jets to 30-6 win over Texans in return. C.J. Stroud leaves late with a concussion

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Tylan Wallace caught the punt cleanly — no easy feat on this wet day — then slipped to his left, spinning away from one potential tackler and racing past a couple of more while barely staying inbounds along the sideline.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walk-off Wallace: Ravens punt returner goes 76 yards for TD in OT in a 37-31 win over the Rams

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The brand of football Minnesota and Las Vegas played on Sunday set the NFL back 16 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings beat Raiders 3-0 in lowest-scoring NFL game in 16 years

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy has an embarrassment of riches surrounding him on San Francisco's high-powered offense. The way he is able get all of them the ball is making the 49ers a nearly unstoppable force.
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuel scores 2 TDs, Purdy throws for career-best 368 yards as 49ers beat Seahawks 28-16

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Sean McDermott thought for a moment that a difficult week for himself and the Buffalo Bills would end with one last gut punch, an audacious touchdown pass by the Kansas City Chiefs with just over a minute left to steal a win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills get go-ahead field goal late, take advantage of Chiefs penalty to hold on for 20-17 win

events.name: Denver Broncos at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Russell Wilson and the Denver Broncos put themselves back in the AFC playoff race Sunday with a 24-7 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers, whose season continues to go further off the rails after quarterback <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Russell Wilson throws 2 TD passes, Justin Herbert injured as Broncos cruise past Chargers 24-7

headlines.description: — Mike McCarthy was nervous for an NFC East showdown with Philadelphia after the Dallas coach missed two days during the week after an emergency appendectomy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott, Brandon Aubrey help Cowboys pull even with Eagles in NFC East with 33-13 victory

headlines.description: — Will Levis knew he couldn't get too caught up on his mistake. The Tennessee Titans' rookie made a bad pitch to running back Derrick Henry in the fourth quarter against the Miami Dolphins, resulting in a fumble that eventually allowed Miami to take a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Will Levis rallies Titans for 2 late TDs, 28-27 win over Dolphins

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New York Giants

headlines.description: — The New York Giants had the ball late in the game, with a chance to rally for an improbable win.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeVito leads clutch drive to Bullock's winning kick as New York Giants top Green Bay Packers 24-22

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Four days was all the Las Vegas Raiders had to recover from their worst performance of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Four days after losing 3-0, Raiders set franchise scoring record, beat Chargers 63-21

headlines.description: — Trailing 17-3 late in the third quarter behind an offense that had struggled to move the ball, the Bengals needed Jake Browning to be nearly perfect — and he was.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Browning shines again for Bengals, rallying them to 27-24 overtime win over Vikings

headlines.description: — Gardner Minshew got the most out of his depleted supporting cast.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gardner Minshew, Colts bolster playoff chances, beat fading Steelers 30-13

headlines.description: — Jared Goff and the Detroit Lions bounced back and took a step toward ending a six-season playoff drought.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws 5 TD passes as NFC North-leading Lions bounce back, beat Broncos 42-17

headlines.description: — For Myles Garrett, there's no explanation for the Browns' strange season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Flacco passes for 374 yards, rallies banged-up Browns to 20-17 win over Bears

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Playing on a new team eager to reach the postseason, Baker Mayfield reversed his December fortunes at Lambeau Field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield throws for 381 yards, 4 TDs, Bucs keep pace in NFC South by beating Packers 34-20

headlines.description: — The Houston Texans gave themselves a confidence boost winning without injured quarterback C.J. Stroud and several other key players.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans win without Stroud, beating Titans 19-16 on Fairbairn's 54-yard field goal in OT

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Mike McDaniel was certain his team would avoid another week of disappointment after the Dolphins saw a 14-point fourth-quarter lead fizzle in less than five minutes in their last outing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mostert, Tagovailoa lead Dolphins to a 30-0 victory over the Jets without Tyreek Hill

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce were at their magnificent best in the first half, and Kansas City's defense delivered another masterpiece against Lamar Jackson and Baltimore, helping the Chiefs reach the Super Bowl for the fourth time in five years...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes, Kelce are headed back to the Super Bowl after Chiefs shut down Ravens 17-10

events.name: New York Giants at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Derek Carr quieted the boobirds in the Superdome and Saints defensive players were the ones making Italian-style hand gestures after a season-high seven sacks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws 3 TD passes as Saints top Giants 24-6 to remain tied atop NFC South

headlines.description: — Panthers interim head coach Chris Tabor has spent three years coaching Eddy Pineiro in Chicago and now Carolina, and his confidence level in the 28-year-old kicker is unwavering.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pineiro's field goal gives Panthers 9-7 win over Falcons, knocks Atlanta out of 1st in NFC South

events.name: Washington Commanders at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — On the second play of the second half, Cooper Kupp found himself running completely alone down the Commanders' sideline behind their NFL-worst pass defense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford throws 2 TD passes, Rams rise in NFC playoff race with 28-20 win over Commanders

headlines.description: — Deebo Samuel was stunned to be so wide open for San Francisco's first touchdown of the game. A few quarters later, Christian McCaffrey had enough time to <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey scores 3 TDs and 49ers clinch NFC West with 45-29 rout of Cardinals for 6th straight win

headlines.description: — The Bills' offense has found its legs in time to make a playoff push.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Cook leads dominant rushing attack as Bills trample Cowboys 31-10

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson was sacked, or so it seemed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens beat mistake-prone Jaguars 23-7 for 4th consecutive victory and clinch AFC playoff spot

headlines.description: — Amid the flood of emotions that continued long after he walked off the field a winner, Drew Lock paused briefly to reflect.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Lock's late touchdown pass rallies Seahawks to 20-17 victory over sliding Eagles

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Sean McVay turned the Los Angeles Rams' already jubilant locker room into a party Thursday night with an announcement: The players are off until Tuesday, allowing them to spend the entire Christmas holiday with their families.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford's Rams start strong, hold off Saints 30-22 to surge forward in NFC playoff race

headlines.description: — Mason Rudolph isn't afraid to admit his mind would drift toward the future as the seasons passed and he remained at the bottom of the Pittsburgh Steelers' depth chart.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rudolph hits Pickens for 2 long touchdowns, Steelers end 3-game skid with 34-11 win over Bengals

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Josh Allen continues to reach milestones in his sixth NFL season, but he's more concerned about getting the Buffalo Bills back into the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen accounts for 3 touchdowns as Bills escape with 24-22 victory over Chargers

headlines.description: — Arthur Smith's goal was for the Atlanta Falcons to remain relevant in the NFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heinicke lifts Falcons with clean play at quarterback in 29-10 win to cool Colts' playoff hopes

headlines.description: — The Seattle Seahawks are winning when it matters most, and they've put themselves right back in the mix for a playoff berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith, Seahawks improve playoff chances in rallying to beat the Titans

headlines.description: — Dan Campbell towered over the podium in a black T-shirt commemorating Detroit's first division title in 30 years, reveling in the moment as the bass from the locker room next door pulsated through the walls.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions hang on to beat Vikings 30-24 and clinch 1st division title since 1993

events.name: Washington Commanders at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Trevor Siemian was able to laugh a little and let out a sigh of relief. And then the Jets quarterback perfectly summed up New York's nail-biter of a win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets blow big lead vs. Commanders but win 30-28 on Zuerlein's 54-yard field goal with 5 seconds left

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — It's still early, but Jordan Love is beginning to show the poise and big-play capability that seem to be prerequisites for a Green Bay Packers quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love, Packers survive rally by Panthers, win 33-30 to keep playoff hopes alive

headlines.description: — After Amari Cooper grabbed a 53-yard reception on the game's first play Sunday, the Cleveland Browns star thought he'd be in for a big day.
headlines.shortLinkText: Amari Cooper has franchise-record 265 yards receiving to lead Browns to 36-22 win over Texans

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers are playing their best when the stakes are highest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield throws for 283 yards, 2 TDs as surging Bucs beat reeling Jaguars 30-12 for 4th straight win

headlines.description: — The Chicago Bears were rolling along with a comfortable lead before things got a little tense, only this time there was no big collapse.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Fields throws for a TD, runs for another score, leading the Bears past Cardinals 27-16

headlines.description: — Jason Sanders had waited all season for this moment. On a Miami Dolphins team that scores more touchdowns than any other in the NFL, the former All-Pro kicker hadn't needed to attempt many field goals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins nip Cowboys 22-20 on Jason Sanders' last-second field goal, secure playoff spot

events.name: New England Patriots at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Bailey Zappe had a feeling this would be the New England Patriots' night when he coughed up the football at his 5-yard line on his very first snap and his defense bailed him out by...
headlines.shortLinkText: Chad Ryland's 56-yard field goal sends Patriots past Broncos 26-23 as Denver's playoff hopes dim

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The smell of the victory cigars wafted down the tunnel beneath Arrowhead Stadium, straight from the Las Vegas Raiders in the celebratory visiting locker room to the despondent home locker room of the Kansas City Chiefs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders stun sloppy Chiefs with 2 defensive TDs in 20-14 victory on Christmas Day

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Yes, of course, Jalen Hurts and coach Nick Sirianni heard the booming chants that echoed throughout the Linc from Eagles fans fed up with the pass-heavy offense that stalled in the second half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles end 3-game skid, maintain control of NFC East title hopes with 33-25 win over Giants

headlines.description: — If the rare late-season matchup between the top teams in the NFL was a statement game, Lamar Jackson and the Baltimore Ravens delivered a loud one to the rest of the league.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson leads the Ravens past the 49ers 33-19 in a showdown of the top 2 teams

events.name: New York Jets at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Joe Flacco has turned a seemingly cursed season into a charmed one.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Flacco throws 3 TD passes and Browns clinch unlikely spot in playoffs with 37-20 win over Jets

headlines.description: — CeeDee Lamb could only watch from the sideline in the final seconds of the best game of his career, hoping it would be enough for a 16th consecutive home victory for the Dallas Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys deny Lions on 2-point try for 20-19 win to extend home win streak to 16

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — The Buffalo Bills acquired cornerback Rasul Douglas at the trade deadline to shore up a depleted defense and reverse the team's slide in the standings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills set up AFC East-deciding finale at Miami with 27-21 win over Patriots

headlines.description: — Justin Fields noticed the smoke in the air and the cigars on a table as he walked into the locker room. By then, the celebration was under way.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Fields, DJ Moore lead way as Bears deal Falcons' hopes a big blow with 37-17 romp

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Jonathan Taylor and Gardner Minshew spent all week talking about the need to take advantage of this week's big opportunity.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taylor, Minshew help Colts stay in AFC playoff chase with 23-20 victory over Raiders

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at New York Giants

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Rams returned to the postseason after a year's absence with a little help following a game during which they didn't look like much of a playoff team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyren Williams runs for 3 TDs as Rams beat Giants 26-25 and clinch playoff berth with Seahawks loss

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts’ desperation heave was intercepted to seal the Eagles' fourth loss this month and one that meant so much more.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyler Murray throws 3 TD passes as Cardinals rally past Eagles, disrupt Philly's playoff path

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The tight NFC South race is going down to the final week of the regular season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws for 2 TDs to help the Saints beat the Bucs 23-13 and tie NFC South standings

headlines.description: — Minutes after rolling to a 27-10 victory at Washington, the San Francisco 49ers watched the final minute of Philadelphia's game at Arizona together in the visiting locker room.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy bounces back, 49ers clinch the NFC’s top seed by beating the Commanders 27-10

headlines.description: — A record-setting day for the Jacksonville Jaguars set up a regular-season finale that will determine their postseason fate.
headlines.shortLinkText: Travis Etienne scores twice, Jaguars end 4-game skid with 26-0 shutout of woeful Panthers

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson and the Baltimore Ravens clinched a division title and the top seed in the AFC.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson's perfect passer rating helps Ravens rout Dolphins 56-19 to clinch top seed in AFC

headlines.description: — When the Houston Texans selected C.J. Stroud with the No. 2 pick in this year's draft, the consensus was that he'd turn this team around eventually.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud has 213 yards and TD as Texans improve playoff hopes with 26-3 win over Titans

headlines.description: — The punishing runs from Najee Harris and Jaylen Warren and a handful of clutch throws from Mason Rudolph have lifted the Pittsburgh Steelers into the final week of the regular season with their playoff hopes still alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers keep playoff hopes alive into Week 18 with 30-23 win over Seahawks

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos got that spark they were looking for with a quarterback switch — from their defense, anyway.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stidham uneven in 1st start in place of Wilson as Broncos rely on defense to beat Chargers 16-9

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Kansas City Chiefs have grown accustomed to wrapping up the AFC West by the middle of December.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harrison Butker hits 6 field goals, kicks Chiefs to AFC West title with 25-17 win over Bengals

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Jordan Love and Aaron Jones put on party hats and popped a sparkling drink in the apex of an all-night celebration for the Green Bay Packers — at <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers take control of playoff spot on Love's 4-touchdown night in 33-10 cruise past Vikings
